description: An illustration, written for this repository's README and tests. It is not the framework's policy and carries no authority: the paper leaves all seven inputs to the verifier. Two persistence types are counted, work (the first signed version of a note or page, or its genesis leaf) and revision (each later version). An epoch is 4320 blocks, about thirty days; a work keeps 9/10 of its contribution per epoch and a revision 3/4. The attestation constants have nothing to act on in this ledger: the recognition set is empty.
